description: Plays the sound backwards. Pinned to submode 1 (REVERSE) of 'modify radical', which bundles seven unrelated transformations (reverse, shred, scrub, lose-resolution, ring-modulate, cross-modulate, quantise); the other submodes can be curated as separate entries later. Takes no parameters — the transformation is a sample-exact reversal (verified: output samples are the input samples in reverse order; duration, channel count and level unchanged).
musical_use: Sample-exact reversal of the source. Classic uses: reversed cymbals or breaths as build-ups, swelling pre-attacks before a downbeat, and reverse-process-reverse sandwiches — reverse, apply a time-directional process (reverb, dovetail, accelerando), then reverse again to put the tail before the attack. Also a cheap way to give attack-heavy material an interesting decay before feeding it to stacking or granular processes.

examples.expected_use: Turn a percussive hit into a swell, or hear a phrase backwards before further processing.
